trust_overview.note: FY2024 report filed as Sabana Industrial Real Estate Investment Trust. During FY2024 the Manager (Sabana Real Estate Investment Management Pte. Ltd.) was an interim manager following the 7 Aug 2023 EGM resolution to internalise; three EGMs convened Mar/Aug/Oct 2024. Internalisation completed post-FY (first internalised SGX REIT). Property Manager = Sabana Property Management Pte. Ltd. (100% owned by SIP via the Manager). Currency SGD. Source p4, p13, p6.

data_with_no_home: Portfolio: 183 tenants across 14 trade sectors as at 31 Dec 2024 (p20/p21)
Tenant retention rate 87.9% FY2024 (p14); WALE by GRI 2.6 years; weighted average unexpired land lease term 26.4 years by GFA (p14)
Total borrowings S$353.0m; 73.7% fixed rate; 100% unencumbered; undrawn facilities ~S$22.0m; cash S$18.5m (p9)
Income available for distribution per unit 3.15 cents; declared DPU 2.86 cents after ~10% retention (p6)
In Jun 2024 issued S$100.0m 5-year 4.15% senior unsecured Sustainability-Linked Guaranteed Bonds due 2029 (first SGD CGIF-guaranteed) (p9)
Investment properties total carrying S$992,929k = Fair value 915,900k + Right-of-use assets 77,029k (Portfolio Statement p130-133)

columns_never_fillable.reason: Per-property NPI not disclosed; only portfolio-level NPI (p6) and operating segments. Property-level discloses only gross rental income (p45-50).
Per-property GLA/NLA not disclosed in the property highlight cards; cards give GFA in sq ft only. Portfolio-level NLA disclosed only in aggregate.
Top-10 tenant table (p21) has no per-tenant trade-sector column; not assigned to avoid unsupported inference. Portfolio trade-sector mix captured separately in trade_mix.json.

reconciliation.line_items_recon: Sum revenue (113,308) - sum expense (89,856: 55,856+17,862+3,241+4,749+379+1+7,768) + sum adjustment signed (148 - 2,306 - 9,339 - 584 = -12,081) = 11,371 = net_income (total return after tax). OK.
reconciliation.net_income_equals: Total return for the year after taxation and before distribution (p126)
reconciliation.note_carrying_bridge: Portfolio Statement (p130-133): Investment properties at Fair value 915,900k + Right-of-use assets 77,029k = Total investment properties 992,929k (= SFP Investment properties line). market_valuation per property = the Fair value column, NOT the ROU-inflated carrying figure.
reconciliation.note_property_revenue: Per-property 'Gross Rental Income for FY 2024' figures (p45-50, rounded to $0.1m) sum to S$72.9m, reconciling to Note 13 'Property rental income' S$72.961m — NOT to total gross revenue S$113.308m (which adds S$40.347m other operating income, mainly utilities/service recoveries, not split per property). reported_total_gross_revenue keyed to the property-rental-income basis so the row-level sum reconciles; full audited gross revenue is reported_full_gross_revenue.

cash_flow_atoms.note: dep_pe: no P&E depreciation line in C/F operating activities (pure-IP REIT). fv_cf_signed: 'Net change in fair value of investment properties' +9,339 in C/F operating (a FY loss added back). finance_costs: gross finance costs 17,862 + finance costs relating to lease liabilities 3,241 = 21,103 (interest_expense_non_operating); finance income 148 NOT netted. capex_sum: Capital expenditure on investment properties 13,755 + Payment of upfront land premium 7,979 = 21,734 (all IP-related investing outflows; interest income received 60 excluded). Source C/F p135.
